measures.what: With shaft pointing up, measure: body length and width just below mounting tabs (exclude tabs); overall tab-to-tab length; mounting hole center spacing along body length and across width; mounting hole/slot width; tab thickness; distance from underside of tabs to bottom of servo. Also say where the cable exits relative to the tabs and bottom.
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo tab thickness: 2.28 mm; servo cable exit: out of one end of the case, below the tabs (where the cable leaves; I didn't measure its size or how far it sticks out)

measures.what: Please confirm the 44.61 mm was the clear gap between the nearest edges of holes on opposite end tabs (not their centers). If possible measure tab-underside to case bottom and cable/plug maximum width and thickness. Plate will surround the body under the tabs; the case will hang below it, so it won't sit directly on a flat base.
